rev.t:
It's an auditorium, which hosted the 10th edition of Bangalore Poetry Festival. Loved the experience!
We walked towards the place, so no idea about parking but there was valet …

Great place for organising concerts and conventions. Acoustics, fairly good. Audience seating arranged in semi circular fashion around the stage, which is clever use of space. Outside, there is space for exhibiting books, curios and a make shift cafeteria.

Visited Indiranagar Sangeetha Sabha on 15th February for our school's annual day event. The venue is well-maintained, with a spacious auditorium and good acoustics, making it ideal for cultural performances. The stage setup was impressive, …
